notes: Simulated closed 2026 calendar year, not actual or forecast company payroll. One Ontario employer, CAD, regular salary only, basic federal and Ontario TD1 claims, CPP eligibility all 12 months and EI-insurable employment. No bonuses, taxable benefits, pensions, union dues, additional withholding, other employment or off-cycle payments. First biweekly payment is a guaranteed full regular payment despite the short onboarding window; no first-pay proration. Salary changes apply to the rate effective at period end. Sam's final regular payment is October 16 for a period ending October 15; all final entitlements are assumed included and no further settlement is due in this sample. Per-period gross rounding is retained without annual salary true-up. Dental code 1: no employer-offered dental coverage. Addresses are sample placeholders; SIN and employer payroll account are intentionally absent. Calculations inherit the existing engine's limited PDOC validation; a closed sample dataset does not certify tax correctness or external completeness.
